rubric_items.reason: Built on the existing AppointmentRepo, AppointmentService guard, injected clock, DAY_MS, migration convention and server shutdown; the in-process timer was asked (A-09) and adds no infrastructure.
Story map covers S-1 to S-5; the cutoff starts_at <= now - DAY_MS satisfies the S-1 AC1-AC3 boundaries, S-2 by the SCHEDULED-only UPDATE, S-3/S-4 by the widened guard and move() resetting status.
Endpoints and fields have type, nullability, format and example, but history[].event format is only 'adds STALE' and CO-1 does not name the APPOINTMENT_STATUSES list it changes.
Choices are cited or decided by A-01..A-10; C9 relies on A-10 but also cites the sibling symbol format.ts:dateTime as module-map evidence for STATUS_LABEL.
Trade-offs cover in-process timer with multiple instances, hourly lag, bulk UPDATE vs loop and concurrency, overlap re-entry on reschedule, and constant vs env interval.
Clear and consistent; CO-9 is placed on a product module although its file lives in the companion repo.

findings.text: C9 cites the sibling symbol format.ts:dateTime as module-map evidence for STATUS_LABEL; the module map does not list STATUS_LABEL, so the only real basis is A-10.

findings.suggested_fix: Drop the dateTime cite from C9 and keep A-10 (optionally add sample-system:web/src/lib/format.ts#L42).

findings.text: The appointments list page builds its status filter from STATUS_LABEL, so CO-7 also adds a Stale filter option; the design does not mention this side effect, and req put list/filter display out of scope.

cites.quote: How Stale appointments are shown in lists, filters or dashboard tiles

findings.suggested_fix: State in CO-7 or EP-1 that the list filter gains a Stale option as a consequence, and that this is accepted.

findings.text: EP-2 history[].event format is only 'adds STALE' instead of the full value set, unlike the status fields which list every value.
findings.suggested_fix: Use format "one of BOOKED, RESCHEDULED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, NO_SHOW, STALE".

findings.text: CO-1 says 'the status list used by the list filter gains it too' without naming APPOINTMENT_STATUSES in api/src/types.ts, the constant that must change.

findings.text: CO-5 has server.ts call markStale(), but server.ts only holds the app and pool; the design does not say how it reaches the AppointmentService instance (app.locals.ctx or its own createContext).
findings.suggested_fix: State in CO-5 which context instance the timer uses to call markStale().
